# Concurrency Checklist: ISK-0004 — Persistence Abstractions & PostgreSQL Foundation

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for transaction boundaries, failure classification, retry, optimistic concurrency, timeouts and cancellation, and advisory locks are complete, clear, and consistent
**Created**: 2026-11-10
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Transaction Boundaries

- [x] CHK001 - Are commit and rollback specified for every way a unit can end: commit, dispose, fault, timeout, and cancellation? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Units of work 4]
- [x] CHK002 - Is the unit's state machine complete, including calls made in a state other than `Open`? [Completeness, Data model §UnitOfWorkState]
- [x] CHK003 - Are the isolation levels offered, the default, and the absence of nested transactions and savepoints specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK004 - Is concurrent use of one unit given a defined outcome? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Units of work 6]

## Failure Classification

- [x] CHK005 - Is every failure class mapped to its code, with observable triggers such as SQLSTATEs? [Completeness, Spec §TR-5, Contract §Failures 2]
- [x] CHK006 - Is timeout told apart from cancellation when both could apply? [Clarity, Research R7, Plan §Risks]
- [x] CHK007 - Is an unknown commit outcome defined, and excluded from retry? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015, Contract §Failures 4]

## Retry

- [x] CHK008 - Are the retry preconditions (class, `SafeToRerun`, known outcome) and the limit specified without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, Research R9]
- [x] CHK009 - Is "3 attempts in all" used consistently, rather than mixed with "3 retries"? [Consistency, Spec §TR-5, §FR-014, §US2 scenario 2]
- [x] CHK010 - Is it stated that an exception with no recorded persistence failure is never retried? [Coverage, Research R9]

## Optimistic Concurrency

- [x] CHK011 - Are a stale token and a missing or foreign row told apart, each with its code? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Research R10]

## Bounds and Cancellation

- [x] CHK012 - Are all three bounds (acquire, statement, unit) defined against configuration and the request deadline? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, Contract §Units of work 7]
- [x] CHK013 - Is the source of the unit's own timeout defined, given TR-13 has no unit timeout field? [Gap, Research R7]
  - Settled during `plan` by the maintainer (research R7): `UnitOfWorkOptions.Timeout`, default 60 s.
- [x] CHK014 - Are the outcomes of pool exhaustion and an already-passed deadline specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK015 - Is server-side cancellation required, and can it be observed? [Measurability, Spec §US2 scenario 7, Tasks T036]
- [x] CHK016 - Are timeouts, pool sizes, the retry limit, and allowances labelled as safety bounds rather than performance figures? [Consistency, Constitution VIII, Plan §Performance Goals]

## Advisory Locks

- [x] CHK017 - Is the key derivation specified to the byte, so it can be reproduced independently? [Clarity, Contract §Advisory locks 2, Research R14]
- [x] CHK018 - Are the lock name and module patterns defined? [Completeness, Research R14]
- [x] CHK019 - Is the effect of an expired bounded wait on the unit's transaction stated? [Clarity, Contract §Advisory locks 3, Data model §IUnitOfWork]
  - Fixed: PostgreSQL aborts the transaction when `lock_timeout` fires, but the contract said only that the wait "fails". The contract, data model, research R14, and T034 now say that an expired bounded wait faults the unit and that a `TryOnly` miss leaves it open.
- [x] CHK020 - Is the "not a lease or fencing token" limit documented? [Assumption, Spec §FR-028, Contract §Advisory locks 4]
- [x] CHK021 - Is non-blocking across scopes specified, and is the effect of a key collision documented? [Coverage, Spec §US2 scenario 5, Contract §Known limits]

## Acceptance

- [x] CHK022 - Are the parallel acceptance outcomes quantified: counts, winners, and consecutive runs? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
